req.title: Root endpoint responds
req.statement: The system shall serve a welcome message at GET / with HTTP 200.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET / must return HTTP 200 with a specific JSON payload. To achieve high mutation kill rate: (1) assert exact status code 200 (catches 201/204/etc mutations), (2) assert exact JSON keys and values (catches string-constant mutations), (3) test that non-GET methods return 4xx (negative path, catches method-routing mutations), (4) assert response Content-Type header contains 'application/json' (catches header mutations), (5) assert each individual field value exactly (catches partial-payload mutations). BVA is applied by checking the boundary between 2xx and non-2xx, and NEG covers wrong HTTP methods.

tests.name: test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload
expected: Response JSON contains message: 'Welcome to Task Manager API'
trace: R-TASK-018: GET / returns HTTP 200 with welcome payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["message"] == "Welcome to Task Manager API"
    assert body["docs"] == "/docs"
    assert body["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert len(body) == 3

test_root_get_returns_200_with_exact_payload()

    client = TestClient(app)
    r_put = client.put("/")
    assert r_put.status_code != 200
    assert 400 <= r_put.status_code <= 499
    r_delete = client.delete("/")
    assert r_delete.status_code != 200

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_root_response_body_is_not_empty_and_is_dict():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert len(body) == 3
    assert len(body) != 0
    assert len(body) != 2
    assert len(body) != 4
